notes: The original suits are back: spy rows 1-6 and merc rows 1-3 are the stock Double Agent looks again, and the community skins come on top: Female Spy - Lara (HD), Spy - Obsidian, Spy - Venom, Spy - Breacher and Female Spy - Viper for spies, Metro Police and Squad Commander for mercs (Skins in the lobby, every player). New in the host's lobby: Change Mode - Classic, Challenge (25%), Infinite and Blackout (spies also win by keeping the ECC off for 60 seconds; the countdown shows in the timer box). Coop moves and the Club House / Warehouse fixes included.
